question: How is surā ranked among the liquors?
premises: Twelve types are indicated in context.
Surā is identified as a liquor.
It is declared supreme among all.
inference: Surā is the supreme liquor among all, O beloved.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic role of dvādaśantu in this verse is compressed.
plain_english: O beloved, surā liquor is the supreme among all twelve.
